  open [appOrUrl] [url]                                                                      Open an app, deep link or URL, save replays

  replay <path>                                                                              Replay a recorded session.

  scroll <directionOrEdge> [amount]                                                          Scroll in a direction or to an edge
  session list                                                                               List active sessions or print the effective daemon state directory
  settings [area] [options]                                                                  Change OS settings and app permissions
  shutdown                                                                                   Shutdown target simulator/emulator
  snapshot                                                                                   Capture accessibility tree or diff against the previous session baseline
  swipe <x1> <y1> <x2> <y2> [durationMs]                                                     Swipe coordinates with optional repeat pattern

Flags:
  --config <path>                                              Load CLI defaults from a specific config file
  --remote-config <path>                                       Load remote host + Metro workflow settings from a specific profile file
  --state-dir <path>                                           Daemon state directory (defaults to ~/.agent-device for packages, or a worktree-scoped dev dir from source)
  --daemon-base-url <url>                                      Explicit remote HTTP daemon base URL (skip local daemon discovery/startup)
  --daemon-auth-token <token>                                  Remote HTTP daemon auth token (sent as request token and bearer header)
  --daemon-transport auto|socket|http                          Daemon client transport preference
  --daemon-server-mode socket|http|dual                        Daemon server mode used when spawning daemon
  --tenant <id>                                                Tenant scope identifier for isolated daemon sessions
  --session-isolation none|tenant                              Session isolation strategy (tenant prefixes session namespace)
  --run-id <id>                                                Run identifier used for tenant lease admission checks
  --lease-id <id>                                              Lease identifier bound to tenant/run admission scope
  --lease-backend ios-simulator|ios-instance|android-instance  Lease backend for remote tenant connection admission
  --session-lock reject|strip                                  Lock bound-session device routing for this CLI invocation and nested batch steps
  --session-locked                                             Deprecated alias for --session-lock reject
  --session-lock-conflicts reject|strip                        Deprecated alias for --session-lock
  --platform ios|macos|android|linux|web|apple                 Platform to target (`apple` aliases the Apple automation backend)
  --target mobile|tv|desktop                                   Device target class to match
  --device <name>                                              Device name to target
  --udid <udid>                                                iOS device UDID
  --serial <serial>                                            Android device serial
  --ios-simulator-device-set <path>                            Scope iOS simulator discovery/commands to this simulator device set
  --ios-xctestrun-file <path>                                  Use an externally built iOS XCTest runner .xctestrun artifact
  --ios-xctest-derived-data-path <path>                        Derived data path for external iOS XCTest runner execution
  --ios-xctest-env-dir <path>                                  Writable directory for per-session iOS XCTest runner env overlays
  --android-device-allowlist <serials>                         Comma/space separated Android serial allowlist for discovery/selection
  --session <name>                                             Named session
  --debug, --verbose, -v                                       Enable debug diagnostics; test --verbose prints per-test step timings without debug logs
  --json                                                       JSON output
  --help, -h                                                   Print help and exit
  --version, -V                                                Print version and exit
  --no-record                                                  Do not record this action

Agent Quickstart:
  Default loop: devices/apps -> open -> snapshot -i -> press/fill/get/is/wait/find -> verify -> close.
  Use selectors or refs as positional targets: id="submit", label="Allow", or @e12 from snapshot -i.
  Plain snapshot reads state; snapshot -i refreshes current interactive refs only.
  Default snapshot text is an agent-facing, token-efficient view for planning and targeting actions.
  Read-only visible/state question: use snapshot/get/is/find; use snapshot -i only when refs are needed.
  Anti-pattern: snapshot -i followed by snapshot -i | grep ...; prior refs stay valid until app state changes, and --force-full is the explicit full re-read.
  Truncated text/input preview: expand first with snapshot -s @e12, not get text.
  React Native apps: read help react-native for Metro, DevTools routing, and RN-specific blockers; use react-native dismiss-overlay for LogBox/RedBox overlays.
  Android RN/Expo Metro: direct Android localhost URL opens with a port auto-configure host reachability.
  Expo Go/dev clients: use the provided URL when given; on iOS prefer open "Expo Go" <url>; Android URL opens infer the foreground package for logs/perf when possible.
  Install flows: install/install-from-source first, then open the installed id with --relaunch.
  Text: fill 'id="field-email"' "qa@example.com" replaces; type appends after press.
  Clearing text: do not use fill <target> ""; use a visible clear/reset control or report that clearing is unsupported.
  Android IME capture: if fill says input was captured by the keyboard/IME, inspect keyboard state and switch/disable handwriting before retrying; do not loop fill/type.
  Implicit default sessions are scoped to the current worktree; use --session only when intentionally sharing a named session.
  Run mutating commands serially within one session; parallelize only read-only commands or separate sessions/devices.
  Clipboard limits: iOS Allow Paste cannot be automated through XCUITest; prefill with clipboard write. Android non-ASCII should use fill/type, not raw adb input.
  After mutation: refs are stale. If the next target is known, use its selector directly; otherwise refresh with snapshot -i, scoped with -s when a stable container is known.
  Raw coordinates are fallback-only: use snapshot -i --json rects when iOS refs no-op or child refs are missing.
  Batch JSON steps use "command" and structured "input"; legacy "positionals"/"flags" steps still run in CLI but are deprecated until the next major version.
  Navigation: app-owned back uses back; system back uses back --system.
  Verification commands must name the expected text/selector; bare screenshots/snapshots are not enough.
  Debug evidence: Session state contains request diagnostics and runner.log; use logs clear --restart/mark/path, trace, and network dump --include headers for app evidence.
  Use agent-device commands in final plans; raw platform tools, pseudo commands, and helper prose are wrong.
  Full operating guide: agent-device help workflow. Exploratory QA: agent-device help dogfood.

Agent Workflows:
  help workflow         Normal bootstrap, exploration, and validation loop
  help debugging        Logs, network, perf memory, and traces
  help react-native     React Native app automation hazards, overlays, Metro, and routing
  help react-devtools   React Native performance, profiling, component tree, and renders
  help physical-device  Connected phone/tablet setup and iOS signing prerequisites
  help remote           Remote/cloud config, tenants, leases, and local service tunnels
  help macos            Desktop, frontmost-app, and menu bar surfaces
  help dogfood          Exploratory QA report workflow

Configuration:
  Default config files: ~/.agent-device/config.json, ./agent-device.json
  Use --config <path> or AGENT_DEVICE_CONFIG to load one explicit config file.

Environment:
  AGENT_DEVICE_SESSION            Explicit session name
  AGENT_DEVICE_PLATFORM           Default platform binding
  AGENT_DEVICE_SESSION_LOCK       Bound-session conflict mode
  AGENT_DEVICE_DAEMON_BASE_URL    Connect to remote daemon
  AGENT_DEVICE_DAEMON_AUTH_TOKEN  Remote daemon service/API token
  AGENT_DEVICE_CLOUD_BASE_URL     Bridge/control-plane API origin for cloud auth and /api-keys

Examples:
  agent-device open Settings --platform ios
  agent-device open TextEdit --platform macos
  agent-device snapshot -i
  agent-device react-devtools get tree --depth 3
  agent-device fill @e3 "test@example.com"
  agent-device replay ./session.ad
  agent-device test ./suite --platform android
